facts.fact: A member of the Ministry of Education team states that it ran the OpenEMIS Core Schools Training for the leadership teams of primary and secondary schools across Mahé (headteachers, deputies and office managers), covering student admissions, promotions and transfers, classes and subjects, and staff records; the post gives no date for the training, so its published date is used.

The post states that a Ministry of Education team facilitated the schools' training on the platform, which it calls the "MoE Seychelles" OpenEMIS platform; undated, so the post's published date is used.

systems.tiers: school leadership teams of primary and secondary schools across Mahé trained

note: Classed emis because the training covers what the school itself does to each student's record: admission, promotion, transfer. The post reports training only, on Mahé only: it does not say any school has begun entering data, so no levels, kept or schools fact is taken. Attendance and results are not among the topics listed.
